verdict.rationale: Box documents a real REST API at https://api.box.com/2.0 with OAuth tokens and curl examples, and has a documented Chunked Upload API, so the upload part of the story is clearly covered. The pack does not evidence the other file operations. missing for 10: documented download endpoint, folder listing endpoint, move endpoint, delete endpoint, independent hands-on corroboration of file operations over the API.

support.subject: As a developer, files move through a real API — upload, download, list, move, and delete over documented REST endpoints, not just a desktop client

citations.quote: API requests use the base URL `https://api.box.com/2.0` and require an OAuth 2.0 access token
The Chunked Upload API provides a way to reliably upload large files to Box by chunking them into a sequence of parts that can be uploaded individually.
